newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour says unemployment double official data.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour says unemployment double official data.

text.p: The true number of people looking for work in the UK is almost 4.5 million, more than twice the official level of unemployment, the opposition Labour party said on Wednesday.

Employment spokesman Peter Hain said in a study that last summer there were 2.1 million "economically inactive" people in the UK and 209,000 others on training schemes on top of the two million officially registered as out of work.
The total number of people seeking work was 4,401,000, he said.
"These figures show why no-one believes the Government's claims about unemployment," Hain said. "The number of people who want a job is more than twice the official number of unemployed."

The report came ahead of Wednesday's official unemployment data, due at 0930 GMT. According to a Reuter poll, economists expect unemployment to have fallen 30,000 in December after November's record 96,000 plunge.
